repo.scope: Current task-owned sparse checkout; not an inventory of every machine or historical commit.

gpuImplementation.actualComputeBackend: Sources/ModelKit/model.py and Sources/TrainKit/train.py use MLX tensor/nn/optimizer APIs. These are real model/training implementations using MLX, not a custom virtual GPU device or direct geometry/Ur GPU service.
gpuImplementation.otherGPUHits: LegalKit taxonomy and MBE generation classify hardware/GPU topics; these are content labels/patterns. tools/hardware_oracle_harvest.py implements pure Python Boolean logic and integer arithmetic, not GPU design, deployment or runtime measurement.
gpuImplementation.coreMLMirror: tools/coreml_deep_harvest_mirror.py imports companion harvest records and enriches metadata; it does not compile or execute CoreML. Two current records are imported corpus evidence.

corpusAndSidecar.sidecarMeaning: Corpus rendering and family-split scripts write provenance/manifests and train/eval text. They do not load inference weights, train implicitly or bind a runtime tool.
corpusAndSidecar.ledgerLimit: GATE-STATUS demotes Ur URRenderKit settle/Metal parity to QA when oracle independence is insufficient; do not promote GPU parity into a third independent oracle. Preserve original schema/labels, imported sidecars, and quarantined/provenance boundaries.
corpusAndSidecar.trainingLink: TrainKit consumes explicitly supplied corpus/tokenizer to run next-token training. It does not automatically consume corpus audit sidecars or copied connected-candidate files.

learnedModelInterfaces.model: ErgeticsLogicModel (exact source spelling) and ModelConfig implement an independent decoder; poc_10m uses vocab16384,width256,8layers,4heads,ffn640; phase1 uses vocab32768,width1024,21layers,16heads,ffn2752. No inference that these weights are the same as the other16384-vocabulary Prime symbolic model.
learnedModelInterfaces.tokenizer: Own clean-room byte-level BPE, base256. BPETokenizer.load reads merges.json and reconstructs the vocabulary. Distinct from PMHNP SentencePiece8192 and Prime byte512.
learnedModelInterfaces.generation: Sources/ModelKit/generate.py reads --checkpoint/weights.npz and --tokenizer/merges.json, encodes literal prompt, evaluates last-position logits, samples or greedy argmax, then decodes newly generated IDs. Uses last512 context tokens. No GPU tool parser or HVC callback binding.
practicalBlocks: No saved model weights or trained BPE tokenizer in this checkout. Source availability alone is not a runnable learned model.
Both generation entry points construct default PoC10M config rather than reading checkpoint config; phase1 weights require matching config before load.

Engine/cli.py:45 formats tok.vocab_size with numeric comma formatting, but Tokenizer/bpe.py:288 defines a method rather than a property. This is a static pre-generation error. The separate ModelKit/generate.py entry point avoids that particular display line.
learnedModelInterfaces.notDone: No default model construction or training was executed during audit; missing assets were not replaced by freshly initialized weights.

bestExistingQuestionAdapter.role: Existing first-party English native language experiment, not ergentics-logic weights and not the symbolic10M model used in domain vCPU runs.
bestExistingQuestionAdapter.tokenizer: prime_native_byte_v1 / ergentics_prime_nfc_utf8_byte_v1; NFC literal question plus LF Answer: LF then original BOS/byte512
bestExistingQuestionAdapter.actualGeneration: Existing compiled NativeTinyDecoder loads retainedweights; full vocabulary greedy output, emits raw IDs and decoded text, postchecks tokenizer/weights, no injected reference answer.
bestExistingQuestionAdapter.bounds: Requested512new tokens, actual min(512,512-promptTokens), no input truncation; native alarm120s and bounded external controller.
bestExistingQuestionAdapter.qualityLimit: Sending a real novel English GPU design question is possible now but engineering-quality output is not established by retained checkpoint tests. No weights were trained on newly connected corpus just by staging it.
bestExistingQuestionAdapter.alternativePMHNPLimit: Original learned SentencePiece and clinical checkpoint; explicitly label that separate lineage.
bestExistingQuestionAdapter.symbolicPrimeLimit: Saved10M domain/symbolic models have fixed symbol input tasks, not a trained arbitrary-English tokenizer interface. Do not substitute byte512/SP tokens by matching integer range.
bestExistingQuestionAdapter.toolBindingLimit: These question adapters generate text only. No existing mechanism lets the generated model response safely choose/build/execute GPU or HVC tools. Any subsequent engineering execution must remain separately attributed and reviewed.
